from pydantic import BaseModel, Field

class DocumentInfo(BaseModel):
    """Extracted information from a single judgment document relevant to task filtering."""
    document_title: str | None = Field(description="The full title of the judgment document (e.g. '民事二审判决书', '判决文书 25')")
    stated_cause_of_action: str | None = Field(description="The specific 'cause of action' (案由) explicitly stated in the document")
    case_category_type: str | None = Field(description="The broader procedural classification (e.g. 'Civil Trial', 'Civil Execution', 'State Compensation')")

class Parse(BaseModel):
    documents: list[DocumentInfo]
